name: decompile_weight_circuit
description: Mechanistically decompile an attention head, MLP projection block, or residual connection from continuous weight matrices into high-level symbolic pseudocode and circuit classifications (e.g., Induction Head, Suppression Head, Memory Slot).

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to the model artifact.

layer_index.description: Zero-indexed transformer layer number to decompile.

head_index.description: Specific attention head index (when circuit_type is attention_head).
